title: [HIP] [FlyDSL] [JIT] [gfx950] Integrate layout-dynamic MXFP8 GEMM with tuning and AOT
body:
## Summary

Port the layout-dynamic scaled GEMM from `flydsl-examples` into AITER
and connect it to tuning, tuned runtime dispatch, and AOT compilation.

Supported modes:
- Native MXFP8: E4M3 data with per-1x32 E8M0 scales.
- E8M0 blockscale: per-1x128 activation scales and 128x128 weight scales.
- Plain or `(16,16)`-preshuffled weights.
- BF16/FP32 output, optional bias, and caller-owned output buffers.
- Full-tile/HTI pipelines, dynamic split-K, and workgroup-local slice-K.

## Integration

- Add an MXFP8 tuner sharing the BF16 FlyDSL HGEMM search axes, adapted
  for scaled MFMA and split-/slice-K configurations.
- Use `ks1`/`ksd` kernel names; the actual split count is a runtime
  argument stored in the CSV `splitK` column.
- Add a separate MXFP8 tuned table to avoid collisions with ordinary
  FP8 and FP32 blockscale configurations.
- Connect native MXFP8 to `tgemm.mm` and block128 preshuffle to the
  existing model-facing GEMM entry.
- Share the layout-dynamic launch ABI between runtime and CPU-only AOT.
- Add standard correctness/performance tests and separate integration
  tests for tuning, output reuse, streams, graphs, inductor, and AOT.

## Difference from #4254

This is a different kernel implementation and scale ABI, not a port or
replacement of #4254.

| | This PR | #4254 |
|---|---|---|
| Kernel | Layout-dynamic pipeline from `flydsl-examples` | Dedicated preshuffle pipeline |
| Operand types | MXFP8 × MXFP8 | MXFP4/MXFP6/MXFP8 combinations |
| Scale interface | Logical E8M0 scales; existing byte-transposed activation scales through the model adapter | Compact-shuffled blockscale or shuffled per-1x32 scales |
| Weight loading | Plain or preshuffled B through the LDS pipeline | Preshuffled B loaded directly into registers |
| Split-K | Dynamic split count; atomic accumulation | FP32 partial buffers followed by reduction |
| Tuning | HGEMM-style tile, stage, wave, HTI, split-/slice-K axes | Preshuffle-specific configuration space |

Callers do not need #4254's compact scale-packing helpers for this PR.
The preshuffle path consumes shuffled weights without runtime unshuffling.

## Validation

- Kernel correctness across scale modes, layouts, output types, and
  split-/slice-K configurations.
- Actual quantizer output through the model-facing preshuffle entry.
- CPU-only AOT followed by fresh-process run-only execution.
- Reuse of one `ksd` AOT artifact across multiple runtime split counts.
- DSv4 dense-GEMM shape coverage and configuration-isolation checks.

## Performance status

This PR does not claim performance parity with #4254. Same-device
measurements show a remaining gap in the current preshuffle pipeline.

The initial DSv4 sweep is validated. Retuning with the expanded search
space is incomplete and was paused for kernel-level performance analysis.
B register loading, scale pipelining, and split-K reduction remain the
main optimization targets.
